english_names: English municipality names are the standard English forms of the official Lithuanian legal names. The address register extract used here is in Lithuanian only.
school_atlas_join: school_atlas_city is set only on a city municipality when the published School Atlas dataset tags campuses with that city name. It is never set on the district municipality that shares the name. Vilnius, Kaunas and Klaipėda city tags therefore do not include the district municipalities.
